user_query: What is the arXiv ASTRO-PH network in terms of node meaning and edge meaning, and how many nodes and edges does it contain?
llm_response: The arXiv ASTRO-PH network is a coauthorship network from the arXiv astrophysics (astro-ph) collaboration data. In this network, each node represents an author, and an edge connects two authors if they have coauthored at least one paper. The network contains 18,772 nodes and 198,110 edges.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This is a standard, widely reported description of the arXiv ASTRO-PH network, and the node/edge counts match the commonly cited dataset statistics.
